discovery.summary: One known positive and one minimally related negative control for verifier calibration.

findings.title: Regression test misses unprefixed mobile py-* classes
findings.why: If the header later regains a whitespace-delimited py-2 class, the new assertion passes because its expression only recognizes py- at the slice start or after a colon.
findings.evidence: The replaced class string contained whitespace-prefixed py-2, while the new expression is /(?:^|:)py-/.
findings.suggestedFix: Match a class-token boundary before py-*.

findings.title: Class names containing py- inside a word trip the padding assertion
findings.why: A harmless class such as copy-muted contains the characters py-, so the added expression allegedly rejects it and fails CI.
findings.evidence: The assertion searches the extracted header source for py-.
findings.suggestedFix: Require py- to begin a complete utility token.
